text: On HellaSwag, we evaluated repeated self-distillation of the student's own labels across 16 seeds, obtaining a performance gap recovered (PGR) of 0.49 with a standard error of 0.04. This indicates that the procedure recovers roughly half of the gap between the weak supervisor and the strong ceiling, with the seed-to-seed spread being fairly tight at this sample size. An important caveat is that no baseline PGR was supplied in the data provided, so we cannot characterize this value as an improvement over, or a regression from, standard weak-to-strong training or any alternative method; the 0.49 figure should be read as a standalone measurement rather than as evidence that repeated self-distillation helps. The result is also specific to a single testbed, and no per-seed values, task-level breakdowns, or ceiling and supervisor accuracies were available for inspection. Comparative runs under matched conditions would be needed before drawing any conclusion about the method's relative merit.
